summary: Sedation led care and a 5 star Google rating are strengths, but conflicting WhatsApp numbers and placeholder text appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The header WhatsApp link appears to use 447723496745 while the footer Follow on WhatsApp link uses 447967774774.
findings.cost: A nervous patient who messages the wrong number may never get a reply.

findings.problem: Menu items Treatments, Fees & Finance and Contact appear to link to #, and no opening hours appear.
findings.cost: Patients cannot reach key pages or see when you are open.

findings.problem: The form appears to contain 'This field is for validation purposes and should be left unchanged.' and 'I'm interested in(Required)' with no options.
findings.cost: Template text on a booking form loses enquiries.

findings.problem: Reviews appear to name Dr Bashir, Dr Bashar, Dr Ala, Dr Alaa and Dr Ali, and the page shows 'MOST AWARDED PRACTICE 2022, 2023 & 2024' with no awarding body.
findings.cost: Inconsistent names and unsourced awards weaken trust.

redesign: Working menu and clean booking form.
